Dose-response curves for IC50 calculation adapted from Babrham Bioinformatics tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yZRvzYsWqJw
Made after "All_growthcurve_output_Oct1_2026". 
Outlier batch J9 is already removed.
Changes made to input file (addition of replicates column) to accommodate dose-response code.
NOTE - APR 2025 - figures modified to only look at control strains.
NOTE - OCT 2026 - figure modified to separately show CNV strain.
This code deals with each CNV strain, one at a time. 


```{r setup, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(forcats)
library(drc)
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)

All_growthcurve_output = read_excel("All_growthcurve_output_Oct1_2026.xlsx")
```


To follow the tutorial mentioned above, this will be calculated for each CNV strain vs all control strains.
That must be done by for loop. But the result of one strain will be shown individually here.

Initial setup data for use in IC50 calculation:
1. Combine all controls from all batches (based on "Combined_outputs_analysis_June15" showing similarity across batches).
2. Create new variable including replicate
3. Plot the data (each replicate visible)

```{r Pilot_strain_data}

Pilot_strain="DGY3301"

Mod_growthcurve_output=All_growthcurve_output[All_growthcurve_output$Type=="Control",]

Pilot_output=All_growthcurve_output[All_growthcurve_output$Strain==paste(Pilot_strain),]

Mod_growthcurve_output=rbind(Mod_growthcurve_output,Pilot_output)

Mod_growthcurve_output$Newsample=paste(Mod_growthcurve_output$Type,"_",Mod_growthcurve_output$Replicate)

ggplot(Mod_growthcurve_output,aes(x=FLC_conc, y=r, group=Newsample, colour=Type)) + geom_line() + geom_point() + theme_bw() + ggtitle(paste("Raw data ", Pilot_strain, " vs All Controls"))

ggplot(Mod_growthcurve_output,aes(x=FLC_conc, y=r, group=Newsample, colour=Type)) + geom_line() + geom_point() + theme_bw() + scale_x_log10() + ggtitle(paste("Raw data ", Pilot_strain, " vs All Controls - log scale"))

#ADDED APR 2025

Controlonly1=Mod_growthcurve_output[Mod_growthcurve_output$Type=="Control",]

ggplot(Controlonly1,aes(x=FLC_conc, y=r, group=Newsample, colour=Type)) + geom_line() + geom_point() + theme_bw() + scale_x_log10() + ggtitle("Control strains - log scale x axis")
```

Find mean grwoth rate for each type (CNV or control) in each FLC conc, and then find the max of these. Normalise all rates by the rele vant max (for control and CNV separately). Tidy and plot normalised data.

```{r tidy_data}

Mod_growthcurve_output %>%
  group_by(FLC_conc,Type) %>%
  summarise(
    max_response=mean(r)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(max_response)) %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-FLC_conc) -> max_rates

max_rates

Mod_growthcurve_output %>%
  left_join(max_rates) %>%
  mutate(
    norm_r=100*r/max_response
  ) %>%
  select(FLC_conc,Strain,Type,Newsample,Replicate,r,norm_r) -> drc_norm

drc_norm

ggplot(drc_norm,aes(x=FLC_conc, y=norm_r, group=Newsample, colour=Type)) + geom_line() + geom_point() + theme_bw() + scale_x_log10() + ggtitle(paste("Normalised growth rate ", Pilot_strain, " vs All Controls - log scale"))
``` 





adding error bar to mean data, and plotting it
```{r error_bar}

drc_norm %>%
  group_by(FLC_conc,Type) %>%
  summarise(
    sem = sd(norm_r)/sqrt(n()),
    response=mean(norm_r)
  ) -> drc_per_condition

drc_per_condition

ggplot(drc_per_condition,aes(x=FLC_conc, y=response, ymin=response-sem, ymax=response+sem, colour=Type)) + geom_line() + geom_point() +  geom_errorbar(width=0.1) + theme_bw() + scale_x_log10() + ggtitle(paste("Normalised mean data ", Pilot_strain, " vs controls - log scale"))

#ADDED APR 2025
Controlonly2=drc_per_condition[drc_per_condition$Type=="Control",]
#ggplot(Controlonly2,aes(x=FLC_conc, y=response, ymin=response-sem, ymax=response+sem, colour=Type)) + geom_line() + geom_point() +  geom_errorbar(width=0.1) + theme_bw() + scale_x_log10() + ggtitle("Normalised mean data- log scale")

#ADDED OCT 2026
CNVonly=drc_per_condition[drc_per_condition$Type=="CNV",]
```

Fitting to IC50 curve.

```{r fitting}
drm (
  data = drc_per_condition,
  formula = response ~ FLC_conc,
  curveid = Type,
  fct = LL.4(names=c("Hill slope","Min", "Max","EC50"))
) -> model

tidy(model)

compParm(model, "EC50", "-")
```

Showing model fit

```{r fit}


dose=c(0,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256,0,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256)
condition=c("Control","Control","Control","Control","Control","Control","Control","Control","Control","CNV","CNV","CNV","CNV","CNV","CNV","CNV","CNV","CNV")
predicted_data = data.frame(
  FLC_conc = dose, Type = condition
)

predict(model,newdata=predicted_data) -> predicted_data$prediction

drc_per_condition %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=FLC_conc,y=response,colour=Type)) + geom_point() + scale_x_log10() + theme_bw() + geom_line(data=predicted_data,aes(x=FLC_conc,y=prediction))

#ADDED APR 2025
Controlonly3=predicted_data[predicted_data$Type=="Control",]

Control_doseresponsemodel=
  Controlonly2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=FLC_conc,y=response,colour=Type)) + geom_point() + scale_x_log10() + theme_bw() + geom_line(data=Controlonly3,aes(x=FLC_conc,y=prediction)) + ggtitle("IC50 model (line) with actual data (points)") + geom_vline(xintercept=21.1,linetype="dashed")

Control_doseresponsemodel

ggsave("Control_doseresponsemodel.pdf", Control_doseresponsemodel, device="pdf")


#ADDED OCT 2026

CNVonly2=predicted_data[predicted_data$Type=="CNV",]

CNV_doseresponsemodel=
  CNVonly %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=FLC_conc,y=response)) + geom_point() + scale_x_log10() + theme_bw() + geom_line(data=CNVonly2,aes(x=FLC_conc,y=prediction)) + ggtitle("IC50 model (line) with actual data (points)") + geom_vline(xintercept=40.5,linetype="dashed")

CNV_doseresponsemodel

ggsave("CNV_doseresponsemodel.pdf", CNV_doseresponsemodel, device="pdf")

```
